n: Child Mind Institute AI Literacy and Student Well-Being lesson
t: A 30-minute lesson on how chatbots work and when students should turn to people.
steps: Find the AI Literacy and Student Well-Being lesson from the Child Mind Institute.
Print the worksheets ahead of time.
Preview video 2 with care. It briefly includes a youth character hinting at suicidal ideation.
Tell the school counselor about the lesson.
Set up audio and video equipment.
Run the polls and the discussion and send the feedback form.
